reasoning: The icon depicts a three-item bulleted list with a plus badge in the lower right corner, clearly signifying creating a new list or adding items to a list. While a todo app itself is already a list, people frequently have tasks whose specific deliverable is compiling a checklist, packing list, guest list, wish list, or punch list. The heavy outline makes the bullets and bars slightly chunky at tiny sizes, where it could briefly resemble a server stack.
